rubric.item: SPEC-11 correctness (locked-test amendments match Q-2/Q-3/Q-4/Q-5, expect counts unchanged)
SPEC-13..15 (command/manual; not run by this reviewer)

findings.issue: useWorkerTimers / restorePausedTimers / axeWithPausedClock (about 40 lines) are copied verbatim into the new spec, making this the sixth copy (action-bar, next-hand, table-display, players-choice, review).
findings.evidence: grep finds 'function axeWithPausedClock' in 6 e2e spec files; e2e/support/ does not export it.
findings.fix: Move the helper to e2e/support/axe.ts (or paused-clock.ts), export it and import it in lineup-choice.spec.ts. The locked specs can switch to it later; this is not required for this story.

findings.issue: The module-level isPreset type guard is used once, by the useState initialiser.
findings.evidence: const isPreset = (name: string): name is LineUpPreset => (LINE_UP_PRESETS as readonly string[]).includes(name);
findings.fix: Optional: inline it, e.g. config.lineUp === 'Custom' ? 'Mixed' : config.lineUp, since LineUpName is LineUpPreset | 'Custom'.

summary: The implementation matches the spec. configForLineUp is configForPlayers followed by lineUpSessionConfig(seatLineUp(...)), with no re-implemented preset rules. botsClockwise sorts by clockwise distance without mutating its input. Game Config adds the labelled Line-up radiogroup, starts at Mixed when lineUp is Custom (A-1), and both the rows and Start game use the same configForLineUp result. DEFAULT_SESSION_CONFIG, DEFAULT_SEATS and seatSession are unchanged (lineUp 'Custom', all TAG). The new tests assert the specified values. Heads-up Tough gives [Seat 1, Ava, TAG]. At 10 players every preset gives 9 rows with distinct names. Soft goes from 6 to 4 players as [1 CS, 2 Rock, 3 CS]. Start game is checked at model level (cash and sit-and-go) and in the browser (table seats equal the listed rows, lineUp is Soft). The button is checked at every size and preset from button 6 and button 10. Locked-test edits: the expect counts per file are identical to the base for all 11 amended files. The routine edits change only names and row order (Q-2). The Q-4 edits add only radio-count entries and the game-type selector scoping. The rapid-pace foldElseCheck fix adds a Fold-exists guard and changes no assertion (Q-5). The only action-bar change is WORDS -> [0x9e3779b9,1,2,0xb8], and every assertion stays the same. I ran it and it passes the unchanged flop ['Check','Bet $4'], turn ['Check','Bet $8'] and 2-button count checks. next-hand and review now expect 'Cal wins $50' with the same seat 2 and cards, and the review entries, badge colours and hand-2 stacks also changed. The stack total is unchanged at 954, and the tests pass. I ran Playwright on action-bar, lineup-choice, next-hand, review, home, table, players-choice, game-type-choice and stake-choice: 66 of 66 passed in Chromium and WebKit. Vitest tests/ui and the lineup-config tests: 70 of 70 passed. I did not run e2e:slow (rapid-pace 200-hand) or the SPEC-13 playtests. No servers were left running. There are no BLOCKER or MAJOR findings: one MINOR (a duplicated e2e axe helper) and one NIT.
